import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k', palette='deep', s=100)

# Add a title and labels
plt.title('Camera Price vs. Megapixels by Sensor Type and 4K Video Capability')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Price in USD')

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type / 4K Video', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
